categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: (1) Traditional wool textile and apparel business, including fine-spun worsted fabrics and professional clothing manufacturing; (2) Ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fiber production for defense, marine, and industrial applications; (3) High-performance differentiated nylon fiber production for outdoor sportswear and functional textiles. The company has established a vertically integrated supply chain from raw material processing through finished product retail.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including: precision combing and spinning for fine worsted fabrics, automated intelligent production lines with 80% equipment automation, 5G+Industrial Internet of Things smart factory systems enabling 72-hour order-to-delivery response, German Barmag and Japanese TMT advanced spinning equipment for nylon production, and proprietary anti-creep UHMWPE fiber spinning technology. The company has developed flame-retardant UHMWPE fiber production capabilities and differential nylon fiber modification techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves international luxury brands and high-end apparel manufacturers as core fabric suppliers, domestic government agencies (public security, courts, finance, telecommunications), large enterprises and state-owned enterprises for professional uniforms, international markets including EU, Japan, USA, Australia and UK, and emerging applications in robotics, marine engineering, and defense sectors. The company maintains strategic partnerships with multiple international fashion brands and serves as a designated supplier for Chinese government institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Longkou, Yantai, Shandong Province. International operations include a wholly-owned subsidiary in Australia (Natsun Australia Pty Ltd) for direct wool procurement, and sales presence in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific regions including Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets in India, Greece, Netherlands, Turkey, and Pakistan. Domestic operations span major economic centers including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire value chain as a vertically integrated manufacturer: upstream in raw material processing (wool washing and combing), midstream in yarn spinning and fabric weaving/dyeing, and downstream in finished apparel manufacturing and brand retail through its 'Dier Marma' brand. The company also participates in new material supply chains for UHMWPE and nylon fibers, positioning itself as both a materials supplier to downstream manufacturers and a finished goods producer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus emphasizes 'innovation-driven, quality-focused, green-oriented' development with dual growth engines: (1) Traditional business optimization through smart manufacturing, high-end customization, and functional fabric innovation; (2) New material breakthroughs in UHMWPE fiber performance enhancement (strength, anti-creep, flame-retardancy) and differentiated nylon fiber development (antibacterial, flame-retardant, bio-based variants). R&D priorities include fiber property optimization, application field expansion, and sustainable material development with 3.56% of revenue invested in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Direct sales of fine-spun fabrics to international brands and domestic enterprises (87.6% of sales); (2) Professional apparel manufacturing and sales through ODM/OEM models and direct retail; (3) High-performance fiber sales to defense, marine, and industrial customers; (4) High-end custom tailoring services; (5) Distributor/agent channel sales (12.4% of sales). Revenue is split approximately 74.5% domestic and 25.5% international, with product mix of 50.1% fabrics, 37.8% apparel, and 10.9% specialty fibers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In traditional wool textiles, the company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier competing with international mills, particularly for high-end Western suit fabrics. In UHMWPE fibers, the company competes with international leaders DSM (Netherlands), Honeywell (USA), and Toyobo (Japan), holding a leading domestic position with differentiated anti-creep and flame-retardant technologies. In nylon fibers, the company enters a market dominated by established producers, leveraging its integrated textile expertise. The company emphasizes technology differentiation and quality leadership rather than cost competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of RMB 1.616 billion (0.98% YoY growth), with net profit of RMB 190.8 million (down 5.82% YoY). Total assets reached RMB 4.622 billion (up 25.64% YoY), with shareholder equity of RMB 2.195 billion (up 8.57% YoY). Operating cash flow improved to RMB 242.9 million (up 11.87% YoY). The company is in a growth transition phase, with traditional business declining 9.54% but offset by UHMWPE fiber revenue growth of 94.75%, indicating successful portfolio diversification toward high-performance materials.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Full-chain integration from raw materials to finished products enabling quality control and rapid customization; (2) Advanced technology capabilities including proprietary anti-creep UHMWPE fiber technology and flame-retardant fiber development; (3) Sustainability focus with bio-based nylon variants and eco-friendly production processes; (4) High-end market positioning with Italian design heritage and international brand recognition; (5) Customization capabilities including 72-hour order fulfillment and MTM (Made-to-Measure) services; (6) Strategic material innovation addressing national defense and emerging technology needs in robotics and marine applications.
